propositions: Expected and self-healing push failures (lost contention races, transient transport retries, routine unpushed backlog) currently emit WARNING-level messages that prime agent sessions to investigate non-issues
Mid-retry transient transport notices and bare ..HEAD suffixes in backlog messages create false outage signals under normal concurrent-writer load
Push contention outcomes must be demoted from WARNING/INFO to DEBUG or suppressed from agent-visible output while keeping policy declines, strict failures, and proven-growing backlogs at WARNING
Messages must explicitly name the tickets branch, state the self-healing contract, and avoid bare ..HEAD suffixes to prevent misinterpretation by LLM agents
The durable marker (PUSH_PENDING) and fsck observability must remain unchanged as operator channels independent of agent-visible logging levels
